text: Same thirty grams: peanuts or peanut butter. Which has more calories?
Almost a tie, because peanuts are already about half fat by weight.

text: The jar adds sugar, hydrogenated oil and salt; sodium jumps from two milligrams to about one hundred forty.
Thirty grams is about two level tablespoons. A heaped spoon holds more, so weigh one once.
